title: pages.notion_link_requested v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the pages module when a page is linked to a page in a member's Notion account (an import, or a sub-page found): the connectors module makes the stream that reads it, after asking this module through the kernel's page-requests port whether the link stands. Ids only. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json. Also published for a table linked to a Notion database (`kind` data_source).

kind.description: What is linked: a page (the default) or a Notion database (data source) as a table; for a database `page` is the table and `notion_page` the data source.
